s1_07_memory_adapter_contract_preflight.boundary: Workflow/Runtime controls execution. Memory/Audit retrieves, stores, audits and consolidates external cognitive memory. Adapter only transports typed requests/results and must not become a second orchestrator.

minimal_request_contract.operation: required; must be one documented Memory/Audit operation
minimal_request_contract.memory_layer: required when operation targets memory; one documented L0-L4 layer
minimal_request_contract.project_ref: required when project-scoped retrieval/storage is used; source docs define PROJECT tag and L3 project memory
minimal_request_contract.task_ref: required when task-scoped retrieval/storage is used; source docs define TASK tag and L2 task memory

source_identity.hash: required when immutable evidence is available

transport_identity.route: required by adapters boundary for external/remote Memory service
transport_identity.evidence_refs: required when request/result depends on evidence

minimal_request_contract.authorization: must be supplied by Runtime/Policy; Memory Orchestrator must not decide authorization
minimal_request_contract.context_budget: required for GET_CONTEXT when a bounded Context Pack is requested
minimal_request_contract.payload: typed operation-specific body; writes carry candidate StateDelta/artifact/claim/evidence/consolidation/checkpoint request, never raw free-form canonical mutation

s1_07_memory_adapter_contract_preflight.write_rule: LLM must never write directly to canonical memory. Adapter must reject or refuse any write lacking normalized/schema-validated/audited provenance required by its operation contract.

minimal_read_response.rule: Memory response is structured data, not a conversational answer

minimal_write_response.new_version: new memory/state version or null when no mutation occurred
minimal_write_response.readback: strong read-back/receipt required before promoting mutation to PASS

local_first_boundary.adapter_rule: HTTPX transport only when Memory service is remote; local implementation must not be forced through cloud transport
